verdict.rationale: JumpCloud serves its API 2.0 description as a downloadable YAML document at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml, which describes endpoints. That is a machine-readable spec an AI-native user can fetch. The probe's 404s on standard openapi.json/swagger.json paths do not contradict this; they only show the spec isn't at conventional, discoverable locations. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of the OpenAPI format/version, evidence of a spec covering the v1 API, discoverability at standard OpenAPI paths, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Specific GET endpoints will allow you to traverse the JumpCloud Graph to return all indirect and directly bound objects in your organization.
